stories.headline: IndiGo restarts some Jeddah and Madinah flights; Riyadh and Dammam stay off till Dec 7
stories.summary: IndiGo has resumed selected flights to Jeddah and Madinah in Saudi Arabia after reviewing the security situation. Flights to Riyadh and Dammam remain suspended until December 7, and the Indian Embassy in Riyadh has issued an advisory confirming this. Earlier cancellations to all four cities ran until November 30.
stories.why_it_matters: Partial resumption helps Umrah pilgrims and Gulf workers, but tension around Saudi Arabia still limits travel.

image.alt: An IndiGo Airbus A320 parked on a wet runway under a blue sky

impact.why: Some Gulf routes come back, though Riyadh and Dammam remain shut.

stories.headline: Government sets five-times-toll penalty for dodging barrier-free tolls
stories.summary: The Road Transport Ministry says vehicles that hide or tamper with number plates, or skip FASTag, to avoid paying on Multi-Lane Free Flow toll roads will pay five times the toll on top of the fee. Cameras that read number plates will catch offenders, and the rule will apply wherever barrier-free tolling is used.
stories.note: Single source: All India Radio (Road Transport Ministry statement).

stories.headline: Rijiju says government will bring major bills in four-day Lok Sabha sitting from Monday
stories.summary: Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju said significant bills will be taken up in the Lok Sabha's special sitting starting Monday, then in the Rajya Sabha from December 2. He rejected opposition charges that the special sitting breaks the rules and urged all parties to let the Houses run smoothly.

stories.headline: US military says it disabled a ship trying to run its blockade of Iranian ports
stories.summary: US Central Command says its aircraft fired at the stern of the Palau-flagged Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman after it left Bandar Abbas, knocking out its engines; it says the crew was unharmed. It is at least the 15th ship the US says it has disabled since the blockade began in April. Iran's navy chief vowed operations to break the blockade.
stories.why_it_matters: Each new clash near Hormuz keeps oil supply risks, and prices, high for importers like India.
stories.note: Claim by US Central Command; not independently confirmed.

image.alt: Cargo ships and tankers anchored in the Strait of Hormuz off Bandar Abbas, Iran

impact.why: Attacks on shipping near Hormuz keep supply fears alive.

stories.headline: Iran's IRGC says two tankers hit mines and caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say two oil tankers caught fire and exploded after striking naval mines, one near Oman's Khasab port and one in the eastern Strait of Hormuz. On Friday the IRGC had said tankers tried to use an unauthorised route. The claims could not be independently verified.
stories.why_it_matters: Mines in the world's main oil chokepoint would raise tanker insurance and freight costs.
stories.note: Claim by Iran's IRGC; not independently confirmed.

impact.why: Mine claims in Hormuz add to supply risk for crude.

stories.headline: Kuwait summons Iran's envoy; Italy says drone that killed two Italians was Iranian-made
stories.summary: Kuwait handed Iran's ambassador a formal protest over a Thursday drone strike on a vital site that killed two Italians. Italy's foreign minister Antonio Tajani says Kuwait's investigation shows the drone was made in Iran. Iran denies launching it and has offered to join a joint inquiry.
stories.note: Kuwait's protest reported by All India Radio; drone origin is a claim by Italy and Kuwait, denied by Iran.

stories.headline: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye vow to defend Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks
stories.summary: Foreign and defence ministers of the Mecca defence pact met in Islamabad and condemned repeated Houthi attacks on Saudi cities and oil sites, pledging to help protect the kingdom. No new military steps were announced. Saudi authorities say at least 26 people have died in suspected Houthi strikes since September 23.

stories.headline: Dollar index ends week near 104 as traders bet on a December Fed hike
stories.summary: The dollar index closed Friday at about 104.0, up roughly 0.3% from Wednesday, as markets priced in a near-certain Federal Reserve rate rise in December. This week's PCE inflation data strengthened bets on several hikes in coming months. Indian markets were shut on Saturday; the rupee last closed at 92.99 per dollar on Friday.
stories.why_it_matters: A firm dollar and rising US yields keep pressure on the rupee when trading resumes Monday.

impact.why: Fed hike bets lift the dollar and US yields, pulling money from emerging markets.
Markets expect a December Fed rate rise.

stories.headline: Wall Street ends its best week since 2022 as tech stocks rebound
stories.summary: In a shortened post-Thanksgiving session, the S&P 500 rose 1.6% to 7,297.49, the Nasdaq jumped 2.31% to 24,129.50 and the Dow added 592 points to 50,774.94. All three gained over 5% for the week; it was the Dow's best week since October 2022. Amazon, Meta and Broadcom led, and newly listed Anthropic jumped about 8 to 11%.
stories.why_it_matters: A strong Wall Street finish could support Indian IT and broader sentiment on Monday after Friday's fall.

impact.why: Big tech rebound drove the best week since 2022.
A strong US tech close tends to lift Indian IT shares.

stories.headline: Brent slips on Friday but heads for a weekly gain on Houthi strikes on Saudi oil
stories.summary: Brent crude fell more than 2% on Friday to just above $94 a barrel but was still up nearly 2% for the week, CNBC said. Attacks by Yemen's Houthis on Saudi energy sites, including a deadly hit on the Jazan refinery on Thursday, kept supply worries alive. US crude was near $82.
stories.why_it_matters: Brent above $90 raises India's import bill and costs for fuel retailers.
stories.note: Single source: CNBC. Yahoo Finance futures data shows a lower Brent price, so no price is given in the snapshot.

impact.why: Houthi strikes on Saudi sites lift risk, but prices eased Friday.
High crude keeps India's import bill heavy.

stories.headline: Silver jumps about 5% as precious metals bounce after a weak November
stories.summary: Silver futures rose about 5% to near $43.70 an ounce on Friday, while gold moved less. Both metals are still sharply down for November as rising US yields and Fed rate-hike bets weighed on them.
stories.note: CNBC entries differ on gold's move; gold price left out.

impact.why: Bargain buying after a steep monthly fall.

stories.headline: OpenAI countersues Apple, accusing it of stealing trade secrets
stories.summary: OpenAI filed counterclaims in a California federal court on Friday, saying Apple used a re-hired former employee to obtain details of OpenAI's planned devices and blocked its access to hardware suppliers. This answers Apple's suit accusing OpenAI of poaching staff. Apple did not immediately comment.
stories.note: Single source: Reuters, via Al Jazeera.

impact.why: Legal fight with OpenAI over AI devices adds uncertainty.

stories.headline: Railways break through 6.59-km tunnel on the Rishikesh-Karnaprayag line
stories.summary: Indian Railways completed the main breakthrough of Tunnel-14, a 6.59 km bore in Uttarakhand's Rudraprayag district, joining a 4.7 km drive from one end with a 1.79 km drive from the other. Crews used daytime-only controlled blasting near villages and special ventilation inside the tunnel. The Himalayan line will link Rishikesh with Karnaprayag.
stories.note: Single source: All India Radio (Railway Ministry).

image.alt: Workers in hard hats hold Indian flags at the rock face of Tunnel-14 after breakthrough

stories.headline: Russia says new Perm nuclear submarine is its first armed with Zircon hypersonic missiles
stories.summary: President Vladimir Putin attended the flag-raising for the Yasen-M class submarine Perm at the Sevmash yard in Severodvinsk, handing it to the navy. Moscow says it is the first submarine fitted with Zircon hypersonic missiles, and Putin said five more nuclear submarines will join the fleet by 2030.
stories.note: Zircon claim by Russia; not independently confirmed. Single source: Al Jazeera (with AFP, Reuters).
